faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions creators ask before switching.
faq.subtitle: Most objections come down to fit, voice, and how much of the workflow you want in one place.

voice.question: Will the AI still sound like me?
voice.answer: That is the goal. Teleflow profiles your existing publishing history so generated drafts stay closer to your vocabulary, cadence, and structure instead of sounding generic.

workflow.question: Do I need to leave Telegram to use it?
workflow.answer: No. Telegram is treated as the input layer, which means you can capture ideas from the place you already work and let the dashboard handle organization, scheduling, and analytics.

billing.question: How does pricing scale?
billing.answer: Plans scale with AI usage and operational depth. You can begin on the free plan, confirm the workflow fits, and only upgrade when your publishing cadence needs more throughput.

team.question: Is this only for solo creators?
team.answer: No. The strongest fit is often creators with a serious schedule, media businesses, or lean teams that want a repeatable operating system instead of a loose tool stack.
